description: This file defines the CashierTxnType class, an immutable, serializable class representing different types of cashier transactions in the domain model for the 'teller' module of Apache Fineract. It includes predefined transaction types as static constants and a method to retrieve a type based on its ID.

classes.name: CashierTxnType
classes.description: An immutable class representing various cashier transaction types, with predefined static instances and a lookup method by ID.

methods.name: getCashierTxnType
methods.description: Returns the CashierTxnType instance corresponding to the given ID, or null if no matching type exists.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the transaction type, which is its value.
